    ISF · Kybliary community

    Community life

    Prayer, work, conversation and service shape everyday community life. These sections explore its spiritual and human meaning without setting out a fixed timetable.

    The Sisterhood — United in Faith and Love

    The lives of the sisters and novices bring together prayer, daily responsibilities and mutual support. Community grows not only through significant spiritual occasions, but also through simple gestures: a kind word, patience, a willingness to help and the ability to listen to one another.

    In this everyday love, the true beauty of Christian life becomes visible.

    01

    Morning — a beginning

    Morning opens a new day of prayer, work and encounters. Gathering our thoughts and entrusting the day to God offers a chance to begin with attention to ourselves and those around us.

    02

    Prayer and spiritual attention

    Prayer makes room for silence, thanksgiving and requests. Turning towards God helps us remember others and seek inward attentiveness among our tasks.

    03

    Daily work

    The kitchen, home, garden and grounds need care. Shared duties express patience, diligence and a willingness to serve a neighbour.

    04

    A shared meal and conversation

    A shared table offers room for conversation as well as food. A willingness to listen and give time supports human closeness in the community.

    05

    Helping our neighbours

    The social kitchen and hot meals for travellers and visitors are tangible forms of service. Simple care for another person gives expression to Christian hospitality.

    06

    Evening prayer

    The evening Rosary is part of the community’s prayer life. The end of a day offers a chance to give thanks, remember those who need support and entrust what has been lived to God.

    Nature and Everyday Life

    The beauty of nature, prayer, work and mutual care bring place and people together in a shared Christian life.

    The stillness of evening

    The wooden bell tower against the evening sky calls to mind a time for thanksgiving and prayer. The beauty of sunset invites us to pause among daily concerns, reflect on the day and turn to God with trust.

    Original photographs supplied by their author for publication.

    Autumn in our shared home

    The autumn courtyard bears the marks of everyday life: buildings, paths, trees and plants cared for by the community. Looking after this place brings work together with gratitude for God’s creation and attentiveness to the people who live and meet here.
